problems: The Elenchus prints no column numbers for the Nicephorus items (first 12 entries) or Stephanus and Procopius; those are body-only. The later items' numbers survive only as a detached block of 11 numbers with 15 titles, so the mapping is inferred from the body and the Ordo.
Elenchus block values 1251-, 1945 could not be tied to titles with certainty (1251- tentatively the Epistola ad Theophilum, 1945 unassigned; Methodius Notitia entry left body-only).
Methodius entry: Notitia altera and Vita auctore Coevo cols (~1233-1242) come from the anchor chain, not an individually checked page.
Several page-number lines are OCR-garbled (31/48 for 37/38, 339 for 329, 973 for 373, 233 etc.); heads were placed by chain and neighbouring anchors, not a plate read.
Crossref columns (597 for Methodius Homilia, 669-684, 545) are as the OCR stub reads them; 597 may be a misread (not checked).
